notes: Reduce repeated Library disk reads with a bounded cache of search fields keyed by file identity, size and nanosecond modification/change times. Changed, replaced, deleted and restored manifests invalidate correctly; transient failures are retried. Full detail and verification reads are uncached.

Unify main-page navigation and browser history. Retain Library searches, media filters and scroll positions, restore Settings categories, reject stale navigation completions and restore history when unsaved changes prevent leaving.
Preserve draft disc notes across tab switches and failed saves. Confirm before leaving unsaved notes; protect in-progress saves and ignore late note responses for another disc.

Remove 48 superseded modal and theme-palette rules and give shared popup surfaces one canonical definition. Preserve theme switching, responsive layouts, warnings and complete-destination-verification safeguards.
